items.title: 15.3.1 Generation and Transmission of Nerve Impulse (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the generation and transmission of the nerve impulse (PDF 30-32).

blocks.text: 1 Impulse se pehle: resting membrane potential

Aaram karta neuron, jo signal nahi le ja raha, polarized hota hai: andar manfi aur bahar musbat. Is ka membrane potential, resting membrane potential (RMP), taqreeban -70 millivolts hai; manfi nishan ka matlab hai andar bahar ke muqable mein manfi hai. Teen cheezein ise qaim karti hain.

items: Fixed anions: proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare manfi charge wale molecules cell ke andar zyada hote aur bahar diffuse nahi ho sakte.

Sodium-potassium pump: K+ andar bahar se taqreeban 30 guna zyada aur Na+ bahar taqreeban 10 guna zyada hai. Membrane ke pumps ATP kharch kar ke in ions ko un ke gradient ke khilaf chalate hain, har do K+ andar ke badle teen Na+ bahar, to andar zyada manfi ho jata hai.
K+ ka risao: kuch K+ ions K+ gates se bahar nikal jate hain. K+ ka yeh ikhraj aur manfi proteins ka andar rehna RMP ki sab se bari wajahein hain.

blocks.alt: Neuron aik daire ki shakal mein. Andar proteins aur nucleic acids 'fixed anions' (jamey hue manfi ions) hain. Andar wala electrode aur bahar wala electrode aik meter se jure hain jis par -70, 0 aur +90 likha hai. Membrane mein Na-K pump 3Na+ bahar aur 2K+ andar karta hai, aur dashed teer K+ ka risao (leakage) bahar dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: RMP ke zimmedar asbab (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Intracellular electrode, Extracellular electrode, Proteins, Nucleic acids, Fixed anions, Neuron membrane, Leakage (K+), Na-K pump (3Na+, 2K+).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is figure mein teen wajahein dekhein jin se neuron ka andar manfi rehta hai: (1) proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare manfi molecules andar phanse rehte hain, (2) Na-K pump har dafa 3 Na+ bahar aur sirf 2 K+ andar karta hai, is liye bahar zyada musbat charge jata hai, (3) kuch K+ khule raaste (leakage) se bahar nikalte rehte hain. Meter ki sui -70 par hai: yahi resting membrane potential (RMP) hai.

Jab neuron sargarm hota hai to kisi hisse par membrane potential ulat jata hai aur andar bahar ke muqable mein musbat ho jata hai. Yeh active membrane potential, ya action potential, hai jo in waqiat se banta hai.

items: Depolarization: Na+ gates khulte aur Na+ andar daurta hai, andar ka manfi charge khatam karta hai; potential -70 mV se sifr se guzar kar +50 mV (kitab ke mutabiq) tak jata hai, chhote hisse par taqreeban aik millisecond ke liye.
Repolarization: Na+ gates band aur K+ gates khulte hain; K+ bahar diffuse hota aur andar phir manfi ho jata hai.
Hyperpolarization: K+ gates der se band hone ki wajah se potential thori der RMP se kuch zyada manfi ho jata hai. Is refractory period mein neuron dobara fire nahi kar sakta.
RMP par wapsi: sodium-potassium pump asal ionic tarteeb bahal karta aur membrane -70 mV par aa kar agle action potential ke liye tayyar ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Membrane potential (-80 se +50 mV) aur waqt ka graph. -70 mV ke RMP (1) se curve tezi se +50 mV tak uthta hai (depolarization, Na+ andar, 2), yeh action potential hai; phir girta hai (repolarization, K+ bahar, 3), -70 se thora neeche jata hai (hyperpolarization) aur RMP par wapas aata hai (4). Chaar chhote panels stages 1 se 4 par Na+ aur K+ gates dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Action potential ka banna (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Panels ki ibarat kitab jaisi: 1 RMP par kuch K+ channels khule hain. 2 Na+ gates khulne se Na+ andar aata hai aur tez depolarization hota hai. 3 K+ gates khulte hain aur K+ ke bahar jane se repolarization hota hai. 4 Membrane ke asal RMP par lautne se pehle hyperpolarization hota hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ko numberon se parhein: 1 par neuron aaram mein hai (-70 mV). 2 par Na+ gates khulte hain, Na+ andar daurta hai aur potential +50 mV tak chala jata hai: yeh action potential hai. 3 par K+ gates khulte hain, K+ bahar jata hai aur potential wapas girta hai. 4 se pehle chhota sa jhukao -70 se neeche jata hai (hyperpolarization), kyun ke kuch K+ gates der se band hote hain; phir pump halat ko RMP par le aata hai.

Action potentials asal mein axon par safar nahi karte; yeh padosi hisson mein dobara bante hain. Aik hisse ka action potential agle hisse ke liye depolarizing muharrik banta hai, jo apna action potential banata hai, jabke pichla hissa wapas RMP par repolarize hota hai.

blocks.alt: Neuron aur us ke axon ki membrane ki aik patti paanch lamhon par, upar se neeche. Har patti membrane ke dono taraf + aur - charges dikhati hai. Pehle resting; phir aik hissa Na+ andar aane se depolarize hota hai (action potential); yeh hissa aage barhta hai aur peeche K+ bahar jata hai; peeche wala hissa hyperpolarized hota hai; aakhir mein membrane resting par wapas.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Action potential ka phailao (kitab ki doosri Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Cell membrane, Resting, Depolarization (Action potential), Hyperpolarization, Resting; Na+ aur K+ ke teer.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche patti waqt ke saath badalti hai. Neela hissa woh jagah hai jahan Na+ andar aa raha hai (andar musbat, bahar manfi): yahi action potential hai. Har agli patti mein yeh hissa daayen taraf barhta hai, aur peeche hara hissa hyperpolarized hai jahan K+ bahar ja raha hai. Is tarah impulse khud safar nahi karta, balke har agla hissa apna naya action potential banata hai.

blocks.title: Stadium ki lehar
blocks.text: Phailao stadium ki 'lehar' jaisa hai: har shakhs apni jagah rehta, khara hota (depolarize), haath uthata (action potential) aur phir baith jata (repolarize), aur lehar aage barhti hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab action potential ki choti +50 mV batati hai; kai kitabein taqreeban +30 se +40 mV deti hain. Kitab refractory period ko hyperpolarization mein rakhti hai; dar asal neuron depolarization aur shuru ki repolarization mein bilkul fire nahi kar sakta, aur hyperpolarization mein mushkil se karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tarteeb dein: repolarization, resting, depolarization, hyperpolarization, aur har sargarm qadam mein kaunsa ion chalta hai batayein.
blocks.explanation: Resting (-70 mV), depolarization (Na+ andar), repolarization (K+ bahar), hyperpolarization (K+ ab bhi bahar), phir resting (pump).

items: RMP taqreeban -70 mV: fixed anions, pump (3 Na+ bahar, 2 K+ andar), K+ ka risao.
Action potential: Na+ andar (depolarization), K+ bahar (repolarization), had se aage (hyperpolarization, refractory), pump bahal karta; har hissa agle ko jagata hai.
